## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin voll im Flow.** — [ish bin foll im floh] — *I'm completely in the flow.*
2. **Das spricht mich total an.** — [das shprisht mish toh-TAHL an] — *That really resonates with me.*
3. **Lass es auf dich wirken.** — [lahss ess owf dish VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in. / Let it work on you.*
